dedupe_keys.name: cbca consumption based carbon accounts analysis code

description: CBCA is the public MATLAB source-code repository used for the Scientific Data analysis of variation in consumption-based carbon accounts. Its README explains how model results are normalised to a shared base year and compared across countries and regions. The code can prepare emissions-account benchmarks for energy or industrial transition simulations and help test sensitivity to the underlying input-output model. It does not simulate an electric grid or factory operation; its outputs are economic carbon accounts that need a separate infrastructure model for physical interpretation. The related Zenodo data release holds the harmonised tables, while this GitHub address holds the processing workflow. GitHub reports a BSD 3-Clause licence. I read own repository metadata and README without cloning or running the code. Version dependencies and reproduction of the paper figures were not tested. No exact catalogue record was identified.
